answer: Pairwise coordination penalties in quadratic funding: the published matching code compares every pair of donors and shrinks the bonus they generate together when they keep backing the same projects. A whale who splits into twenty accounts to forge a crowd leaves twenty near-identical donation histories, so matching falls back toward their plain total and the extra wallets only add fees. The pearl of the scheme is that it needs no ID check; the cost is that a genuine cluster, say a juniper-growers' club, also gets less matching.
